audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Lucian while whys[4] and spikes[2] both say Grandmaster at Arms eats his all-in and closes the kill; 2+ items was given to Jax while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say he out-scales hard once he has two crit items.
audit.why: The two rows are exact inversions of the sentences that render beside them, and 2+ items is the row that decides how the player plays the whole game.
audit.corrected: Row 4 = Jax, row 6 = Lucian, matching the packet chart and the whys, with ratings moved to match. One atomic group across both layers; rows 0-3 and 5 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you eleven times to 'engage when Relentless Pursuit is down' but never gives its cooldown, and never mentions that the cooldown is not a fixed timer.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and barely moves with rank (16/15.5/15/14.5/14), but Lightslinger attacks reduce it. So counting to sixteen after he dashes gets you killed — you have to count the autos he lands in between. That is the single most useful concrete fact in the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and dosFull[0].d, with Piercing Light's 9s-to-5s added.
sources: enemyKit E cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 and text 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] ended with 'E-counter his KA, Q-W burst' — placeholder text — and dosFull[1] is titled 'E-Counter Strike his Relentless Pursuit', which tells you to parry a dash.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges attacks. Lightslinger's double-shot is basic attacks, so it is exactly what E eats, and every shot he fires into the dodge feeds the recast. Piercing Light is a spell and lands through it. Relentless Pursuit is a dash and there is nothing to dodge at all. Also worth knowing: Lucian's passive empowers his next two attacks whenever a nearby enemy is immobilized — your own stun turns his autos on.
audit.corrected: report[5] and dosFull[1].d rewritten to name what E eats and what it does not.

audit.why: 52.32% over 2544 games is the largest sample in this slice and matches FAV.

notes: All four suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: "Relentless Assault's" is Jax's passive (correctly named), "Counter Strike's" and 'Hold Counter Strike' are Jax's E, and 'Save Relentless Pursuit' is the correct name after a verb. NOT WRITTEN because it needs a source I do not have: Lucian's passive empowers his next two attacks when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, which means your own Counter Strike stun arms his follow-up autos. The kit states the trigger but not whether it fires off an enemy immobilized by the Lucian player's own team versus any immobilize, so I recorded it in the audit rather than putting it on the page.
